items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Associate degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training with a minimum two years automotive industry experience.
Experience supervising employees to include duties associated with recruitment and selection, coaching, training, evaluating performance, and performing corrective action.
Experience using reservation programs and dispatching vehicles.
Experience gathering data and to analyze complex vehicle reports to make decisions on best use of vehicles (i.e. purchasing, disposition, assignments, replacements, etc.).

Experience in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, to effectively operate a personal computer, to perform word processing, data entry, general typing, manage database, email, calendaring, and spreadsheet development. Experience in a call center, dispatch, or similar environment.

Under the general direction of the Fleet Operations Supervisor, supervise the Fuel and Vehicle Preparation Operations, Rental and Dispatch Operations, Student and Staff scheduling and training, and Equipment Inventory. Responsible for the acquisition and disposition of vehicles; specification and purchasing of vehicles by bid or State Contract; parking/toll ticket resolution; creating and maintaining various metrics determine outsourcing fill requests for long and short term assigned vehicles based upon customer request and inventory; Collect and analyze data to produce metrics for various aspects of vehicle utilization; Assist Fleet Operations Supervisor on various projects as needed.

Skill to organize work effectively to achieve timely progress on multiple simultaneous projects, distribute effort appropriately among projects, meet deadlines and maintain a high level of productivity.
Skill to operate Fleet Services specialized fleet management information system with emphasis in the areas of fuel and asset management.
Skill to independently identify and rectify discrepancies in Fleet Services fuel management systems and vehicle billing.
Knowledge of Kuali and use of applicable policies and procedures.

Interpersonal and communication skills to clearly and effectively interact with a diverse group of individuals; secure and/or provide information to clarify situations, resolve problems, negotiate services and/or agreements with other departments or external agencies.
Knowledge of Fleet Maintenance Information Systems (FMIS) and the ability to learn new FMIS. Ability to update vehicle records in FMIS.
